text:
Maya (Product): quick design review — attaching a short thread about the compact spend timeline I pushed this morning. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx -> focus is microinteractions for token breakdown and ordering of token stacks.
Sam (PM): saw it, nice! main ask from growth: make token breakdown scan-friendly on first glance (no hover required).
Leo (Eng): heads up: continuous hover animations for every sparkline will kill FPS on low-end devices. prefer on-demand expanded view or precomputed summary points.
Anya (A11y): +1 on avoiding hover-only. need keyboard focusable controls and ARIA labels on the sparkline & token stacks. users with screen readers need readable summaries.
Maya (Product): agreed. option A: always-show compact numeric badges next to the sparkline, option B: show badge on keyboard focus and hover. Thoughts?
Sam (PM): A seems safer for conversion tests. but mobile real-estate is tight, maybe B for mobile, A for desktop.
Leo (Eng): implementation note — we can precompute 7-point aggregation per day to reduce rendering. also would prefer CSS-only focus ring for perf.
Anya (A11y): example ARIA snippet for the sparkline:
```html
<svg role="img" aria-label="7-day spend trend: rising 12% compared to previous week"></svg>
<button aria-controls="token-breakdown" aria-expanded="false">Tokens</button>
```
Maya (Product): adding that to the figma comments. also small copy tweak: current label is "Estimated monthly spend" — proposal: "Estimated monthly cost" (more explicit).
Sam (PM): +1 to "cost". aligns with invoices language.
John (Revenue): flag — when we move token breakdown to always-visible badges, make sure invoice export still maps token columns to cost buckets correctly. customers ask for CSV with token_id, model, tokens, cost_usd.
Tess (Design Ops): two placement options for org vs project scope toggle: top-left near timeframe selector, or inline within the spend card header. Option 1 makes global scope obvious; Option 2 keeps cards self-contained. I mocked both.
Maya (Product): my preference Option 1 for discoverability; Option 2 if we want per-card overrides later. also check dark-mode contrast for badge text (Anya).
Anya (A11y): contrast nits: badge text in figma is 3.8:1 on the darker background — needs 4.5:1 for body. propose increasing weight or using an inset border.
Leo (Eng): Dev-bot deployed a preview build with the sparkline aggregation and keyboard focus. preview: https://preview.redwood/branch/spend-compact-1966
Dev-bot: build #462 deployed to preview. snapshot: https://ci.redwood/snapshots/462
Maya (Product): thanks — I'll validate the microinteractions and update the spec:
- Desktop: always-show 3-digit compact badges next to sparkline
- Mobile: badge visible on tap/focus only
- Keyboard: badge appears on focus; sparkline has aria-label summary
- Copy: replace "Estimated monthly spend" -> "Estimated monthly cost"
- CSV: include token mappings per John request
Sam (PM): can we add a small tooltip on badge hover with exact token counts and a link to invoice detail? keeps UI lightweight but surface detail.
Leo (Eng): tooltip ok if it's DOM-based and reuses precomputed data. heavy tooltips + many rows may still cause jank; we can lazy-init tooltip on first hover.
Anya (A11y): tooltips must be accessible: use role="tooltip" and ensure they can be triggered by focus.
Tess (Design Ops): I'll upload the two placement mocks and a condensed mobile flow by EOD.
Maya (Product): plan: iterate on figma with Anya's contrast fixes + Sam copy change. Eng, can you schedule a perf check with a handful of low-end devices after Tess uploads?
Leo (Eng): yes, will run perf checklist and post results in this thread by tomorrow.
John (Revenue): ping me when CSV schema is drafted; happy to sign off on fields.
Maya (Product): thanks all — will update figma and post a short Loom summarizing decisions. :sparkles:
